governance_policies.policy_statement: Only a baseline entitlement or current admin-issued resource grant permits a source read.
required_review_conditions: Validate employee role and active employment
Validate exact resource ID and assigned project if applicable
Evaluate grant validity and revocation at read time
Treat absence of grant as deny
governance_policies.recipient_access_restriction: Recipients must be checked for source-level or disclosure-only eligibility.
governance_policies.evidence_provenance_requirement: Retain original source and record IDs with timestamps.
governance_policies.versioning_requirement: Immutable versioned content, timestamp and approving admin binding.
governance_policies.audit_requirement: Decision and state transition must refer to a durable audit event.
governance_policies.revocation_or_supersession: Revoke current effect; preserve historical decision and issued versions.

governance_policies.policy_statement: Only ADMIN may approve, narrow, deny, expire or revoke restricted-source grants.
required_review_conditions: Project lead recommendations have no decision authority
Audit each issuance, revision and revocation
Intern grants for code or admin sources remain denied
